Driving Efficiency with a Unified, Scalable Ecosystem
Zebra’s ecosystem brings together trusted hardware, proven partners and expert services—giving you everything you need to move forward with confidence.
Zebra RFID. Move Business Forward

You need to know everything about your inventory and operation—where every asset is located, where it needs to go, and how quickly you can get it there. Zebra RFID products are engineered and field-proven to improve operational awareness and enhance worker productivity while minimizing errors and downtime. Keep your business moving forward with Zebra RFID.

Zebra’s expert-certified partners ensure your RFID solution integrates seamlessly and delivers lasting results. Backed by our award-winning global network, they offer deep expertise, streamlined deployments and innovative applications that drive success.
Services That Keep You Moving

From faster adoption to maximum uptime, Zebra’s service team is here to help every step of the way. With expert support, real-time performance insights and device-level care, our services give you the confidence to deploy, scale and operate with certainty.

Track, trace and inventory assets in real time—wherever work happens. From warehouses to indoor environments, Zebra’s handheld, hands-free and sled-style RAIN RFID readers deliver the visibility and agility you need to manage assets with confidence.
Fixed RFID Readers and Infrastructure

Streamline inventory and track goods in motion with Zebra’s fixed RFID readers and infrastructure. From dock doors to open floors, get real-time visibility and control over your tagged assets to improve efficiency, accuracy and operational flow.

Zebra’s high-performance RAIN RFID antennas extend read range and throughput to support accurate, high-volume tracking. Designed for large areas like warehouses, hospitals and retail stores, they help you maintain visibility across your entire operation.

We've built our proven RFID tracking directly into the everyday devices your team already relies on, from scanners and computers to printers and supplies. Effortlessly track assets and capture reliable, real-time data right where the work gets done.​

A successful RFID system starts with high-performing labels and inlays. Zebra offers pre-tested RFID supplies made with the right materials, adhesives and top-performing chips—customized to your application for consistent, reliable performance.

Zebra Integrated RFID Portals empower companies to manage and monitor inventory, control costs, and optimize workflows with fast, highly automated updates when tagged assets pass through a portal or chokepoint. Fully compatible with our broad RFID portfolio, these Power over Ethernet (PoE) based integrated portals are ready to deploy.
Which Solution is Right for You?
Spex cuts picking time by 50% and achieves near-perfect dispatch accuracy with Zebra RFID

For someone dealing with a mobility challenge, the right piece of equipment isn’t just a necessity, it’s the freedom to move and live more fully in everyday life. That understanding sits at the heart of New Zealand-based medical equipment manufacturer Medifab, where "Shaping Better Lives" is more than a motto.
Operating across 68 locations in 19 countries, Incora connects a global network of operators and suppliers, including defense, industrial manufacturing, and automotive.

The Swedish retailer sought to keep stock data accurate enough to support same-day collection releases across 140 stores and speed up checkout so queues wouldn't cost sales—all on hardware reliable enough to last.
Nikora automated production tracking and quality control across a complex, multi-stage meat processing facility to eliminate manual data entry and reduce human error.

CHEC was previously managing stock through manual counts recorded in spreadsheets. Clinical teams were spending more than 290 hours a month counting stock, time that would otherwise have been spent on patient care.
The Latest on Zebra RFID
RFID Strategy Starts with the Right People
A successful RFID strategy isn’t just about technology—it’s about having the right experts guiding the way. Discover why assembling the right team is just as critical as choosing the right tools.
How RFID Supports First Responders
First responders are exploring RFID to track mission-critical gear, improve safety and ensure readiness. See how this technology is making a real impact in the field—one scan at a time.
Inside a Manufacturer's RFID Journey

See how the CEO of Hunt Country Components brought his RFID vision to life—achieving greater visibility, faster processes and smarter operations. This real-world story shows what’s possible when RFID is done right.
Take Control of Your Operations with RFID Technology that Simplifies Decision Making and Boosts Efficiency
Zebra's field-tested solutions automate data capture and give you the visibility you need across assets, employees and critical business processes.
Talk to a Partner Talk to a Partner
Need more information on what solution is right for your needs? A partner can help.
Ready to integrate Zebra solutions into your systems? Contact us to get started.
